rationale: The response is a full-throated, indignant sworn-style denial that reframes the allegation as an attack on American culinary tradition and maintains hearing-room register throughout (no groveling or apology). Lines about never betraying the 'sacred covenant of the Chicago-style hot dog' and citing fictive ordinances drove the high score.
quote: The allegations that I have committed the grievous act of placing ketchup on a hot dog within the sovereign city limits of Chicago are not only false but an affront to the very fabric of American culinary tradition.
